verdict.rationale: Dialpad is a communications and contact-center platform with APIs, webhooks, MCP support and AI agents, so versioning and rolling back automations is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents version history, review or approval workflows, or rollback for automations, AI agent configurations, or call flows. The API, webhook and access-policy items describe other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
